questions.question: What is the repair boundary?
questions.decision: Only R1/R2/R4 in fig-286 and R3 in EN prose/11/text.
questions.basis: Direct human instruction and exact D078 findings; no canonical or other-worker writes.

questions.question: Must the small traces acquire a physical identity?
questions.decision: No. Preserve unlabelled visual structure; neither inventory nor assertions claim local field or current.
questions.basis: D078 R4 explicitly supports this structural route; source pixels show strokes and arrow slopes, not independent physical identity.

questions.question: How are all printed B-prime labels retained?
questions.decision: Retain both printed labels as separate labelled objects, relocate them with visible leaders to the known modern axial induced-field annotation.
questions.basis: D078 R1/R4 permit justified text-binding relocation. Pixel positions and relocation are recorded separately. No main B trace is renamed.

questions.question: What may change in English?
questions.decision: Use the exact R3 sentence with literal current math markup; preserve every other sentence and all source/math fields.
questions.basis: Direct instruction and reviewer exact wording. Native flow may only change its affected final paragraph, not section boundaries.

questions.question: What is evidence versus approval?
questions.decision: Native draft validation/render and author observations only. Independent affected review remains pending; no review@1, finalization, promotion or full lesson display.
questions.basis: Direct instruction, production-resume and quality-gate. Reused prose approval and mathematical proof do not settle new figure semantics.

questions.question: Should dependencies, backend state or capability freshness be rerun?
questions.decision: No. Read-only existing byte-identical renderer runtime and saved d061 authority suffice.
questions.basis: Same ongoing capability; explicit no freshness/live/backend/paid calls and no models, dependency, skill or runtime copying.
